title: Trend Micro Apex Central Scheduled Update Server-Side Request Forgery Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to disclose sensitive information on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex Central. Authentication is required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the handling of URLs in the Scheduled Update feature. By providing a crafted URL, an attacker can cause the server to make a request to an incorrect URL. An attacker may be able to leverage this vulnerability to gain improper access to network resources.
